summary: Recorded a learning that the te9_dev source tables (bookmarks, bookmark_content, bookmark_analysis) are read-only mirrors populated by an external Raindrop sync that does NOT live in this repo — so grepping for sync code will find nothing. Includes live-DB evidence (sync ran 2026-08-06, 2,446 rows) and the related gotcha that the homepage "2,270" count is hardcoded in +page.svelte:141.
